form.label: Engine Health
form.description: Is the lab working, is data arriving and parsing, and what does each detection cost to find. The search cost panels are the ones that decide whether this engine survives a larger index.

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler savedsearch_name="Sigma Engine*" status=success | stats count
index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler savedsearch_name="Sigma*" (status=continued OR status=skipped) | stats count
index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler concurrency_limit=* | rex "concurrency_limit=(?<lim>\d+)" | stats max(lim) as lim | fields lim
index=_internal source=*metrics.log group=per_sourcetype_thruput | timechart span=5m sum(kb) as KB by series useother=f

panel.title: Indexing lag — event time to index time

search.query: index=linux_lab | eval lag = _indextime - _time | stats count as events, median(lag) as median_lag, perc95(lag) as p95_lag, max(lag) as max_lag by sourcetype | eval median_lag=round(median_lag,0), p95_lag=round(p95_lag,0), max_lag=round(max_lag,0) | eval verdict=case(median_lag < 300, "healthy", median_lag < 3600, "lagging", 1==1, "timestamps not extracted") | sort - events | rename sourcetype as "Source type", events as "Events", median_lag as "Median lag (s)", p95_lag as "p95 (s)", max_lag as "Max (s)", verdict as "Verdict"

panel.title: Field extraction coverage — the fields the rules depend on

search.query: index=linux_lab sourcetype IN ("XmlWinEventLog","sysmon:linux") | stats count as events, count(Image) as Image, count(CommandLine) as CommandLine, count(ParentImage) as ParentImage, count(User) as User, count(EventCode) as EventCode by sourcetype, Channel | eval "Image %"=round(Image/events*100,1), "CommandLine %"=round(CommandLine/events*100,1), "ParentImage %"=round(ParentImage/events*100,1), "EventCode %"=round(EventCode/events*100,1) | table sourcetype, Channel, events, "Image %", "CommandLine %", "ParentImage %", "EventCode %" | sort - events

index=_internal (component=AggregatorMiningProcessor OR component=DateParserVerbose OR component=LineBreakingProcessor) (log_level=WARN OR log_level=ERROR) | rex "data_sourcetype=(?<st>[^,\s]+)" | eval fault=case(match(_raw,"MAX_EVENTS"), "events glued together (no line breaker)", match(_raw,"outside of the acceptable time window"), "timestamp out of range", match(_raw,"Failed to parse timestamp"), "timestamp not parsed", 1==1, component) | stats count by fault, st | sort - count | rename fault as "Fault", st as "Source type", count as "Occurrences"

panel.title: What each batch costs — the panel that decides whether this scales

search.query: index=_audit action=search info=completed savedsearch_name="Sigma Engine*" | rex field=savedsearch_name "Sigma Engine - (?<platform>\S+) (?<severity>\S+) (?<batch>\d+ of \d+)" | stats count as runs, sum(scan_count) as scanned, sum(event_count) as matched, sum(result_count) as detections, avg(total_run_time) as avg_s, max(total_run_time) as max_s by savedsearch_name, platform, severity | eval selectivity = round(matched/(scanned+1)*100, 4), scan_rate = round(scanned/(runs*avg_s+0.001), 0), per_detection = if(detections>0, round(scanned/detections,0), null()), projected_s = round(avg_s * $scale_tok$, 1), verdict = case(projected_s > 900, "will not finish", projected_s > 300, "too slow", selectivity < 0.01, "reading for nothing", 1==1, "ok") | eval avg_s=round(avg_s,2), max_s=round(max_s,2) | table savedsearch_name, platform, severity, runs, scanned, matched, detections, selectivity, scan_rate, per_detection, avg_s, projected_s, verdict | rename savedsearch_name as "Batch", runs as "Runs", scanned as "Events read", matched as "Matched", detections as "Detections", selectivity as "Selectivity %", scan_rate as "Events/sec", per_detection as "Read per detection", avg_s as "Avg run (s)", projected_s as "Projected (s)", verdict as "Verdict" | sort - "Events read"

index=_audit action=search info=completed savedsearch_name="Sigma Engine*" | rex field=savedsearch_name "Sigma Engine - (?<platform>\S+) (?<severity>\S+) " | timechart span=15m sum(scan_count) by severity useother=f

panel.title: Scheduler lag — how late a run starts

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler savedsearch_name="Sigma*" status=success | eval lag = dispatch_time - scheduled_time | timechart span=15m avg(lag) as "average", max(lag) as "worst"

panel.title: Rule yield — what the deployed set is actually earning

search.query: | inputlookup sigma_rules.csv | fields sigma_rule_id, sigma_platform, sigma_level, sigma_disposition | join type=left sigma_rule_id [ search index=sigma_alerts earliest=-7d latest=now | stats count as detections by sigma_rule_id ] | eval detections = coalesce(detections, 0), fired = if(detections > 0, 1, 0) | stats count as rules, sum(fired) as firing, sum(detections) as detections by sigma_platform, sigma_level | eval "Never fired" = rules - firing, "Firing %" = round(firing/rules*100, 1) | table sigma_platform, sigma_level, rules, firing, "Never fired", "Firing %", detections | rename sigma_platform as "Platform", sigma_level as "Severity", rules as "Rules deployed", firing as "Fired", detections as "Detections" | sort "Platform", "Severity"

panel.title: Noisiest rules — candidates for tuning or allowlisting

search.query: index=sigma_alerts | stats sum(sigma_match_count) as events, count as detections, dc(sigma_src_host) as hosts by sigma_rule, sigma_level | eval "Events per detection" = round(events/detections, 1) | sort - detections | head 15 | rename sigma_rule as "Rule", sigma_level as "Severity", detections as "Detections", hosts as "Hosts", events as "Events matched"
